# Calculus 1 — summary

| Need | Formula / method |
|---|---|
| Derivative of $x^n$ 📘 | $nx^{n-1}$ (rewrite $\dfrac{1}{x^k}$ as $x^{-k}$ first) |
| $e^x$, $\ln x$ 📘 | $e^x$, $\ \dfrac{1}{x}$ |
| Tangent at $x = a$ 🧠 | $y - f(a) = f'(a)(x - a)$ |
| Normal at $x = a$ 🧠 | gradient $-\dfrac{1}{f'(a)}$ |
| Increasing / decreasing | $f'(x) > 0$ / $f'(x) < 0$ |
| Stationary points | $f'(x) = 0$ |
| Max / min 🧠 | $f''(a) < 0$ max · $f''(a) > 0$ min (or sign of $f'$) |
| Inflexion 🧠 | $f''(x) = 0$ **and** changes sign |
| Concavity 🧠 | up $f'' > 0$ · down $f'' < 0$ |

**Graphs:** max / min of $f$ ↔ roots of $f'$ · inflexion of $f$ ↔ max / min of $f'$ ↔ roots of $f''$.

**Limits:** estimate from a table or graph; the derivative is the limit of chord gradients.

**Rates of change:** $f'(a)$ with units (e.g. cm$^3$ s$^{-1}$).

**Watch out:** "justify" needs the sign of $f'$ or $f''$ written down · the point is $(a,\ f(a))$, not $(a,\ f'(a))$.
